company_name: SHENZHEN DONG RONG XING YE ELECTRONICS CO.,LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides a range of equipment and materials specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shenzhen Dong Rong Xing Ye Electronics Co., Ltd. specializes in supplying diverse high-quality equipment and materials for the semiconductor and electronics industries. With over 25 years of experience, they offer advanced processing equipment and technical services to support technological upgrades and industrial progress.
capabilities: semiconductor packaging production equipment (plasma cleaners, laser marking machines)
various ceramic substrates from the Japanese NTK brand

regional_presence.China: The company has established offices and a processing plant in Shenzhen, with business operations covering Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan.
regional_presence.Taiwan: They have a presence in Taiwan to support their business development in the region.
regional_presence.Hong Kong: Operations extend to Hong Kong as part of their regional strategy.
